title: Send a custom event
summary: A custom event lets a component tell its surroundings that something happened.

blocks.text: A custom event lets a component tell its surroundings that something happened. Its detail field carries a small value.
Run these HTML examples in this site's HTML playground. Each example defines its own custom element in a fresh page. No extra JavaScript library is needed.

blocks.title: Send a custom event

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `textContent` reads or replaces plain text inside an element. It does not interpret the supplied words as HTML.
`addEventListener` waits for the named event before calling the function you pass to it.
`createElement` makes a new element in memory. Append it to the document when you want it to appear.

blocks.text: Clicking the internal button sends book-chosen. The outer listener shows Moon Trip.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Events from inside a shadow root need composed: true to cross that boundary. This example dispatches on the host itself.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change the event detail to another book title.
